signals.signal: Swipe-away rate is now the #1 ranking signal for Shorts distribution, surpassing raw watch time as the primary indicator of whether distribution expands.
signals.raw_quote: The most important metric is the ratio of swipes to views, which now occupies first place among all indicators.

signals.signal: Shorts with 70%+ completion rates receive ~30% more algorithmic promotion; improving retention by 10 percentage points correlates with 25% more impressions.
signals.raw_quote: Over 70% completion rates yield roughly 30% more algorithmic promotion.

signals.signal: 50-60% of viewer dropoff happens in the first 3 seconds; the opening window is the single highest-leverage moment for faceless Shorts.
signals.raw_quote: 50-60% of viewers who drop off do so within the first 3 seconds.

signals.signal: On-screen text during the hook increases average watch time by 18%; text makes faceless content legible on mute and creates pattern interrupts.
signals.raw_quote: Shorts with on-screen text during the hook see 18% more watch time on average.

signals.signal: Pattern interrupts in the first 5 seconds boost average retention by 23% versus a static opening.
signals.raw_quote: A pattern interrupt in the first 5 seconds boosts average retention by 23% versus a static opening.

signals.signal: Looping structures (15-25 second optimal length) can push average view duration past 100%, as each loop counts as a new view since March 2025.
signals.raw_quote: Looping structures push average view duration past 100%.

signals.signal: Shorts older than ~30 days are now much less likely to be pushed in recommendations—a significant shift away from the evergreen compounding model.
signals.raw_quote: Shorts older than roughly 30 days now much less likely to be pushed in recommendations.

signals.signal: January 2026: YouTube introduced a dedicated 'Shorts' search filter, significantly increasing discoverability for searchable/topic-driven Short content.
signals.raw_quote: YouTube introduced a 'Shorts' type filter in search results, separating short-form vertical content from traditional long-form videos.

signals.signal: Inserting micro open loops every 5-8 seconds in the middle section ('But here's the surprising part...') prevents the typical mid-roll retention cliff.
Post-watch satisfaction signals (surveys, shares, replays, session continuation) now weigh equally with engagement metrics in distribution scoring.
signals.raw_quote: Distribution now weighs multiple engagement types equally: post-watch survey responses, likes and shares (shares = strongest endorsement signal), rewatches and replays, session continuation.
